news.title: Kyle Connor scores a pair of power-play goals as Jets squeak past Red Wings 3-2
news.ruTitle: Кайл Коннор забивает пару голов в большинстве, когда «Джетс» обыгрывают «Ред Уингз» со счетом 3–2.
news.description: — Kyle Connor scored two of Winnipeg's three power-play goals and added an assist on the third as the Jets held off the Detroit Red Wings 3-2 on Sunday.

news.title: NHL Tonight: Mammoth, Rangers square off in key interconference matchup
news.ruTitle: НХЛ сегодня вечером: Мамонт и Рейнджерс сразятся в ключевом матче межконференций
news.description: There are five games on the NHL calendar on Sunday. Here's what to watch in each of them.

news.title: Utah visits New York after Schmaltz's 2-goal game
news.ruTitle: Юта посетила Нью-Йорк после игры Шмальца с двумя голами
news.description: Utah Mammoth (2-0, in the Central Division) vs. New York Rangers (2-1, in the Metropolitan Division)

news.title: Senators visit the Bruins in Atlantic Division action
news.ruTitle: Сенаторы посетили "Брюинз" на матче Атлантического дивизиона
news.description: Ottawa Senators (1-0, in the Atlantic Division) vs. Boston Bruins (2-1, in the Atlantic Division)

news.title: Sharks in action against the Stars after overtime victory
news.ruTitle: Шаркс в бою против Старз после победы в овертайме
news.description: San Jose Sharks (2-0, in the Pacific Division) vs. Dallas Stars (0-2, in the Central Division)

news.title: Pacific Division opponents meet when Seattle hosts Calgary
news.ruTitle: Соперники Тихоокеанского дивизиона встретятся, когда Сиэтл примет Калгари
news.description: Calgary Flames (0-2, in the Pacific Division) vs. Seattle Kraken (1-1, in the Pacific Division)

news.title: Flyers take 3-game losing streak into matchup with the Lightning
news.ruTitle: «Флайерз» прервали серию из трех поражений в матче с «Лайтнинг»
news.description: Philadelphia Flyers (0-1-2, in the Metropolitan Division) vs. Tampa Bay Lightning (1-1, in the Atlantic Division)

news.title: Sabres F Kulich returns from blood clot issues, nets winner
news.ruTitle: Сэйбрз Ф. Кулич возвращается после проблем с тромбами, победитель по воротам
news.description: Nearly a year of worries of whether he was ever going to play again, while he recovered from a blood clot issue, washed away as Buffalo Sabres forward Jiri Kulich scored the go-ahead goal with 6:40 left to secure a 4-3 victory over the Chicago Blackhawks.

news.title: Merilainen makes 23 saves in first start for the Canucks in a 4-1 victory over the Flames
news.ruTitle: Мерилайнен делает 23 сейва в первом старте за «Кэнакс» в победе над «Флэймз» со счётом 4:1.
news.description: — Leevi Merilainen made 23 saves in his first start for Vancouver and the Canucks had a four-goal third period in a 4-1 victory over the Calgary Flames on Saturday night.

news.title: Chernyshov's 2nd goal of the game gives the Sharks a 5-4 overtime win over the Kings
news.ruTitle: Второй гол Чернышова в матче принес «Шаркс» победу над «Кингз» со счетом 5:4 в овертайме.
news.description: — Igor Chernyshov scored his second goal of the game with 1:42 remaining in overtime and the San Jose Sharks beat the Los Angeles Kings 5-4 on Saturday night for their second straight win to open the season.

news.title: Necas and Roy score quick goals as the Avalanche rout the Blues 6-1
news.ruTitle: Некас и Рой забивают быстрые голы, когда «Лавина» разгромила «синих» со счетом 6–1.
news.description: — Nicolas Roy and Martin Necas scored 23 seconds apart in a four-goal second period, and the Colorado Avalanche beat the St. Louis Blues 6-1 on Saturday night.

news.title: Kaprizov scores twice as the Wild beat the Bruins 4-1
news.ruTitle: Капризов забивает дважды, когда «Уайлд» обыграли «Брюинз» со счетом 4–1.
news.description: — Kirill Kaprizov scored twice, Jesper Wallstedt made 26 saves, and the Minnesota Wild beat the Boston Bruins 4-1 on Saturday night.
